scientific_integrity: The scalar zero-forcing number and motivating initial seed patterns are known from arXiv:2310.18513; only the additional exact token-jumping exchange graph structure, its counts and connectivity are assessed. This is not independently audited and exhaustive priority verification is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats generalized gears with m>=4 spokes, r>=1 intermediate rim vertices per interval, ordinary zero forcing and token-jumping among minimum sets. The three-spoke boundary and exact exchange-graph diameter are not claimed. Finite enumeration supplements but does not replace proof.
title: Connected zero-forcing reconfiguration on generalized gear graphs
